name: MissionStatement - Default Wording
description: The Our mission band with no entry copy at all, so it renders its own wording: the OUR MISSION eyebrow, the heading 'Building a global alumni community to' with its crimson tail 'inspire and steward the future of tech.', the official HAA-recognized SIG line, and the three goals as a row under crimson rules. This is what an editor who empties the entry still gets, rather than a blank band.
